Later, I ordered a Surmai Fish Thali for my mom since she loves fish, and she absolutely enjoyed it. The fish was fresh, perfectly cooked, and full of authentic coastal flavours. The Portion sizes were satisfying, and the pricing felt reasonable for the experience offered.
Overall, the staff and service was good, the food tasted amazing, and we had a satisfying time at CP Fishland. Definitely worth visiting again!

​The food, particularly the seafood, was nothing short of a revelation. I can unequivocally say that I have never tasted fish prepared with such perfection. If you’re looking for authentic seafood and a satisfying thali experience in Mira Road, don’t miss this hidden gem. Highly recommended, and definitely a place I’ll keep coming back to! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

featured_reviews.review_text:
Service Review: Ashish Aquarium – Mira Road East / Bhayander

I was recently in search of a Goldfish aquarium tank setup along with proper guidance on maintenance, fish care, and long-term sustainability. After asking around locally, I was recommended to contact Ashish Aquarium, run by Mr. Ashish, located in Bhayander.

During my first visit to the shop, Mr. Ashish wasn’t available as he was on a job call, but I was warmly welcomed and guided by his father. The very next day, Mr. Ashish personally called me to understand my requirements. I was pleasantly surprised by how promptly and professionally he followed up. On the same day, he visited my place for a detailed measurement and consultation.

What really stood out was how Mr. Ashish took the time to truly understand my vision for the tank setup. He didn’t just sell a product—he shared valuable insights, tips, and tricks about fishkeeping, tank maintenance, and how to create an optimal environment for Goldfish. His approach was collaborative and thoughtful, suggesting solutions that balanced aesthetics, functionality, and the well-being of the fish.

Mr. Ashish is clearly passionate about aquariums, and it reflects in every aspect of his service. He is calm, soft-spoken, and genuinely enthusiastic about trying new setups and solving challenges. His customer-first attitude is refreshing—he isn’t just running a business, he is building long-term relationships. I never felt rushed or pushed to make decisions; instead, I felt supported and well-informed throughout the process.

I’m genuinely glad to have found someone like Mr. Ashish, who values both quality and trust. I’m confident he will continue to support me with my aquarium journey and provide guidance whenever needed.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for an honest, skilled, and passionate aquarium professional in the Mira Road–Bhayander area.

🌊 A Hidden Treasure for Aquarium Enthusiasts in Mira Road! 🐠✨

I recently decided to upgrade my basic GloFish aquarium and was on the lookout for something extraordinary — not just another tank, but a true aquatic experience. After scouting through numerous shops across Mira Road and Bhayandar, I finally stumbled upon a true gem, all thanks to a trusted recommendation from a close friend.

As they say, “To discover a rare gem, you must dig deep — not just through places, but through passion.” That’s exactly how I found Ashish Aquarium, a humble-looking shop nestled near Namaskar NX in Mira Gaon.

At first glance, it might seem like a small store — easy to overlook. But step inside, and you’ll be welcomed into a world of aquatic wonder, run by Mr. Ashish and his lovely family. What sets this place apart is not just the wide variety of fish or equipment, but the depth of knowledge, passion, and integrity they bring to the table.

Ashish isn’t your typical shopkeeper. He’s a certified marine and fisheries expert and a true aquarium consultant in every sense. He doesn’t just sell you an aquarium — he listens, understands your vision, and then curates a setup that matches your personality, lifestyle, and experience level.

I walked in with aquascaping in mind, but stayed open to ideas. Ashish, with his keen intuition and expertise, suggested a stunning marine setup — something I hadn’t seriously considered before. His explanation of the ecosystem, compatibility of species, maintenance expectations, and visual appeal was so thoughtful and patiently delivered, it completely changed my perspective.

What truly amazed me:
✅ Exceptional quality materials
✅ Unbeatable pricing
✅ Swift installation turnaround
✅ Post-installation support & optional AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts)

They don’t just build tanks — they craft underwater ecosystems that are beautiful, balanced, and built to thrive.

💬 “A great aquarium doesn’t start with equipment, it starts with understanding.” That’s the philosophy you’ll feel at Ashish Aquarium.

To anyone dreaming of building a beautiful aquatic world — whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned hobbyist — I highly recommend visiting all your favorite stores. But once you walk into Ashish Aquarium, trust me, you’ll find your forever go-to place. It’s not just about what you buy — it’s the experience, trust, and connection that makes the difference.

🙏 Thank you, Ashish, for transforming my idea into a masterpiece. Can’t wait to share the photos of my marine setup soon! 🐠🌿🌊
